exact_prompt:
Use case: faithfulHD game diffuseUV edit, exact source material/count preservation.
The reference is the ENTIRE original128x128 storedRGB image enlarged NEAREST4x to512x512, no artistic change. Original alpha remains separate. Edit the WHOLE source square in place; preserve every source island/edge/black gap, orientation, normalized UV position and pattern scale. No assembled scene/object, no crop/padding/fitting/rotate/recenter/zoom/border or changed layout. Native source coordinates below are only constraints, NEVER drawn text; attached guide is4x those coordinates.
Keep the original dull gray blade on the far left with its existing soft longitudinal bevel/groove. Keep the brown grip at upper-middle: its core native x36..54,y29..90 has EXACTLY SIX tapered brown sections: y29..39,41..50,52..61,63..71,73..81,83..90, with FIVE original dark dividers at rows40,51,62,72,82. Retain their nonuniform original spacing/taper and faint uneven painted shading, never add a seventh segment or new regular stripes. Preserve original small top mounting field and its ONE existing pale square dot, original dark top cap/open region, existing lower gray crossbar, and the single lower-left metal eyelet with ONE dark opening. Preserve both long reddish-brown leather sheath fields at middle-right/right, original seams/soft bends/black breaks and ONE existing pale square dot on upper right sheath. Keep these exactly TWO source pale square marks at native original positions/sizes; do not reinterpret as new screws or engraved lettering. No new rivets/holes, no missing original marks, no invented seam/strap/buckle.
Only replace coarse pixel steps with subtle fine painted detail at the SAME original material and pattern scale. Muted gray/silver metal stays softly painted; dark brown leather stays dark brown, olive painted material stays olive. Preserve faint source tone, smooth plain areas and original relative highlight strength; very fine source-like grain only where originally present. No coarse grit/crust/rust pits/new scratches/mottling, no decorative curls/rays/glints, no brighter weak sections, no sharpened glowing edges or raised teeth/black grooves, no added physical parts. Exact original component counts/positions/forms. No symbols, logo, letters, numbers or new inscriptions. Output only the ENTIRE original square UV texture as opaqueRGB with no whitespace or labels.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST4x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
